description: courtscheduler refused the reservation or the call to it failed. 'code' is the only field a consumer should branch on; 'reason' is courtscheduler's own text plus the HTTP status, for the operator log and for diagnostics - it is not a user-facing message and is not translated. Only NO_CAPACITY and NO_SESSION mean the chosen session is the problem; the rest are technical. Adding a code here is a public-contract change and must match ProvisionalBookingFailureCode, since the framework drops a published event whose payload fails this schema.
